value.text: Dashboard.requestRefresh URL-encodes the place ID and sends POST /places/{id}/refresh, waiting up to ten seconds before forwarding the response status and JSON body. A fetch or JSON-decoding error returns 503 PLACES_UNAVAILABLE. The saved process links this call to Places.Refresh and the request-publisher/consumer views, but the HTTP target binding is an agent proposal. The links do not establish execution order, response outcome, provider refresh or Kafka delivery; runtime routing remains unknown.
